360	in the Heavenly assistance. We learned the Gemara in Tractate Sanhedrin. Now the Zera Berach comes and says
361	something wonderful. The Zera Berach says: come and see a wonder in the words of our Sages,
362	in the Midrash Rabbah on this week's parasha. I'll read it to you. Rabbi Levi said: do you know
363	what the angels looked like?
364	Do you know what the angels looked like?
365	One looked a certain way. Rashi writes that they all looked like Arabs. That is what Rashi writes.
366	I want to ask you: in that period, were there Arabs?
367	So how did they look like Arabs?
368	Arabs started with Abu Mazen, so where do Arabs come from?
369	What Arabs?
370	In that period there were Ishmaelites. What Arabs, at the head?
371	Where did the Arabs come from?
372	What is "Arabs"?
373	They looked like Arabs.
374	But that is what is written in Rashi, in the Gemara, Tractate Bava Metzia: they looked like Arabs.
375	What does "like Arabs" mean?
376	Gentlemen, before we get into this matter, beyond what we brought earlier, that HaShem said
377	"and I am old." The commentators give another explanation. What is the other explanation?
378	"And I am old," HaShem said: wait until the first elder of the Creation comes.
379	Who is the first elder of the Creation?
380	Avraham Avinu, in this week's parasha.
381	"And Avraham and Sarah were old, advanced in days."
382	Was Avraham Avinu old?
383	Not at all.
384	How old was he when the Torah writes that he was old?
385	Ninety-nine years.
386	That was when the brit happened, right?
387	After the brit, "and Avraham ceased," and Sarah, the guest here, the women.
388	In our parasha, how old was he?
389	Ninety-nine.
390	What is ninety-nine compared to one hundred eighty years?
391	How long did Avraham need to live?
392	How long should he live?
393	One hundred eighty years.
394	In fact he lived one hundred seventy-five.
395	Why?
396	Because HaShem promised him he would be buried at a good old age.
397	He promised him he would be buried at a good old age, so what?
398	He would not see Esav go to a bad culture.
399	So since Esav went to a bad culture, HaShem took him five years before the time.
